rule_b: this bundle, where stated: >=1 geometry-ELIGIBLE placement
rule_c: this bundle, where stated: >=1 CANONICAL placement
note: not a disagreement: a call whose geometry is ineligible or non-canonical still exists as a call. Every rate in this bundle names which rule it used
denominator: loci of that family label; the three columns are three declared coverage rules over the same loci, not three estimates of one number
